كَوْثَةٌ What is composed of four leaves, and of five: referring to growing corn and the like: n. un. of كَوْثٌ. (TA.) ＝
-A2- كَوْثَةٌ, or ↓ كُوثَةٌ , [as in different copies of the K, the latter being the reading in the TA, which mentions كويثة as another reading,] Abundance of herbage, or of the goods, conveniences, or comforts, of life; plenty; fruitfulness. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
